# Release Readiness Checklist

A lightweight checklist to verify readiness for a release. Use this checklist before marking a release as ready for production.

- [ ] Product acceptance criteria met and signed off by Product Manager
- [ ] QA sign-off: critical test cases executed and passing
- [ ] Automated test suite passing on main branch (unit/integration/e2e)
- [ ] No open high/critical severity defects blocking release
- [ ] Release notes drafted and reviewed
- [ ] Migration/rollback plan documented (if applicable)
- [ ] Deployment runbook and owners assigned
- [ ] Monitoring and alerting configured for new changes
- [ ] Stakeholders and Sponsors notified of release window
- [ ] Post-release validation plan in place

Notes:
- If any of the above items are not complete, capture the risk and mitigation and re-evaluate readiness with the Project Manager and Sponsor.
